name: Recipes — Add Recipe validates required fields

planSteps.description: Enter 'testsprite@herbary.test' in the Email field and 'Testsprite123!' in the Password field, then click the 'Log In' button
Wait until the nav bar shows 'My Recipes', then navigate to /add-recipe
Type 'Short' into the Name field, leave ingredients empty, type 'too short' into Instructions, and click 'Create Recipe'
An error message 'Please fill in name, at least one ingredient, and instructions (10+ characters).' is visible
